compared_view: raw Agent 1.1.0; the H1-guarded view never enters the H2 decision
precedence: H2 MEASUREMENT INVALID: any invalid_if condition
H2 REGRESSED: any hard_regression dimension worse than the comparator
H2 MIXED: a material_worsening drop (>= the stated count) together with at least one improved dimension
H2 REGRESSED: a material_worsening drop with no improved dimension
H2 MIXED: at least one improved and at least one worse dimension
H2 IMPROVED: at least one improved dimension and none worse
H2 REGRESSED: at least one worse dimension and none improved
comparison_unit: numerators over identical frozen denominators (22 cases, 15 required requests, 7 sufficient cases, 3 reference and 3 ambiguity cases); counts compared exactly, no tolerance except material_worsening
